assign.card: core/Router: task folders open with no 404 probes

set.title: core/Router: a session-store task folder opens without 404 probes up its ancestors
set.text: From mastermind-system-architect-3 (2026-10-23), seen in mastermind-deputy's merge smoke: any page linking to session-store task folders fails the smoke on 404s that already happen on michael/dev. The router or StoreFolder's ancestor walk probes each ancestor's page.js and .md, plus old record names, before it finds session.jsonl. On worktree/qf-3 the deputy made AITask, StoreFolder and Task.open_ref probe session.jsonl first, which took the session page from 22 errors to 0; the rest is the ancestor walk. Evidence: $TEMP/dry-qf3c.txt (40 FAIL, all linked task folders). Fix: the walk asks the folder listing (files.jsonl) which file exists instead of probing; prove with a smoke run on the session page's Work tab.

priority.why: blocks a clean smoke on the Work tab; the same failures happen on michael/dev

log.msg: WALKERS (found with CDP initiator stacks on /…/session-e00f55c9/sessions-and-tasks/deputy/roles/). (1) StoreFolder.js:104 route(): AITask.has(url+'page.js') on the session folder -> 404 session-e00f55c9/page.js. (2) AITask.js:84 route(): per nested level HEAD-probes <sub>/session.jsonl, <sub>/task.jsonl, <sub>/page.js; whichever is absent 404s (sessions-and-tasks/session.jsonl, sessions-and-tasks/page.js, deputy/page.js, roles/page.js). (3) AITask.js:109 session() -> JSONL.live -> Store.record_url (Store.js:61): a nested task folder is not matched by the 'session folder' regex, so it HEADs task.jsonl first -> 404 deputy/task.jsonl, roles/task.jsonl even though route() just found session.jsonl. (4) AITask.js:133 requirements(): fetches <session>/requirements.md with no listing check -> 404. Not this walk: /directory.json, /framework/ai/tasks.json, page-work.json, usage.json, */weight.jsonl, sessions.json etc. 404 only because those git-ignored/dev-generated files are absent in a worktree. The Router (Router.js) and Page.child (Page.class.js:363-400) themselves add nothing for these urls: route() claims the name before Page.load/page.js runs.

decision.text: Add one dev-server route GET /api/folder-names?dir=<site path> (Server/plugins/FolderNames.js) that answers a folder's entry names with a 200, and make AITask.has(url) ask it once per folder (cached 10 s, like AITask/listing.js) instead of HEAD-probing; record name and requirements.md also read from that one answer. Off the dev server (no route) has() falls back to the old HEAD probe.
decision.alternative: (a) files.jsonl listing: PageFiles.js in_session_cache() skips ai/sessions/YYYY/** entirely, so nothing writes it there (gitignored and absent) and it never covers nested task folders. (b) session store indexes: sessions.json/session-index.json/session-tree.json are untracked dev files, tasks.json only holds 53 recent tasks and not deputy/roles; the tracked task-moves.jsonl and task-pages.json cover only the pre-move tasks (task-pages lists 107 of 224 page.js folders); the tasks Query index is async over the socket and route() must answer synchronously, and it has no page.js fact. (c) stop the walk at the session root: record names are mixed inside one session (task.jsonl and session.jsonl siblings), so a guess still 404s.

SMOKE before/after on deputy/roles/: 8 errors (page.js, session.jsonl, task.jsonl, requirements.md walks + env) -> 6, all git-ignored dev data absent in a worktree (sessions.json, session-tree.json, session-index.json, spend-tree.json, openrouter-reconcile.json); zero walk 404s. Session page: 3 env errors before and after (same files). /framework/ ok, /framework/core/Page/ ok; Task.test.mjs 60/60. Leftover FAILs under /framework/core/Page/navigation/ are untracked shots (levels-1920.png, layouts shots), directory.json and a tabs URL error, none from this walk.

STALE DOCS for the mastermind: Server/readme.md (new plugin FolderNames, route /api/folder-names), ai/AITask readme (has() is now a listing lookup; session() picks the record name). Known small gap: a one-segment session folder with only task.jsonl still gets one 404 from Store.record_url asking session.jsonl first; not part of the nested walk.

findings.text: The readmes are out of date (Law 9, "document the structure as you build"). `Server/readme.md` doesn't mention the new `Server/plugins/FolderNames.js` or its `/api/folder-names` route, and `ai/AITask/readme.md` still describes `has()` as a HEAD probe and doesn't say that `session()` now picks the record name. The minion's own log admits both ("STALE DOCS for the mastermind"). It is a small edit and belongs on this branch.

The decision line says the folder listing is "cached 10 s, like AITask/listing.js", but the code caches it for 3 s (`AITask.js` `names_in`, `Date.now() - hit.at < 3000`). The record and the code should agree.

`AITask.route()` now uses two folder-listing systems side by side: `listing.js` `names()` reads `/framework/directory.json`, which `Server/plugins/Directory.js` says is frozen, and `AITask.has()` reads the new `/api/folder-names`. A simpler fix is to make `listing.js` `names()` ask `/api/folder-names` and drop the directory.json branch in `route()`, so the site has one folder listing, not two (Law 6). This can be a follow-up.

Off the dev server (the static production site), the first `has()` call costs one 404 on `/api/folder-names`, and then the old HEAD probe runs. `AITask.session()` also adds one HEAD for `session.jsonl` that `Store.record_url` made before. Nothing breaks, but it adds requests.

The new route is in `Server/`, so the owner's dev server only gets it after a restart. Until then `no_listing` makes `has()` fall back to the old probes, so the old 404s return but nothing breaks. Say this when the branch merges.

`FolderNames.js:27` calls `decodeURIComponent` on `req.query.dir`, which Express has already decoded. A folder name holding a literal `%` makes it throw, and the request returns a 500. The `..` guard and the `startsWith(PUBLIC)` check still hold, so this is not an escape.

I re-ran the smoke myself on `deputy/roles/` and on the session page. No `page.js`, `session.jsonl`, `task.jsonl` or `requirements.md` 404 is left. Both still FAIL with 6 errors: five git-ignored dev files that a worktree lacks (`sessions.json`, `session-tree.json`, `session-index.json`, `spend-tree.json`, `openrouter-reconcile.json`), plus a console budget of 17 > 5 from JSONL "unknown verb" warnings on `session.jsonl`. Neither comes from this walk, so the merge smoke will still show red.

log.msg: CORRECTION to the decision line: the folder-listing cache lasts 3 s (listing.js), not 10 s; listing.js's old directory.json cache was 10 s, and that code is gone.

REVIEW FIXES: 37f4c17c2 readmes (Server/readme.md route, ai/AITask/readme.md has()/session()); 4cc1f0f75 one listing: ai/AITask/listing.js names(dir) asks /api/folder-names (only AITask imported it; AITask.route() now one branch for dated and sessions-store folders, the directory.json branch is gone), asks nothing when Store.local() is false (new static in core/Item/Store.js, also used by Store.open), FolderNames.js no longer double-decodes (a literal % returns 200 {names:[]}, was a 500); fe4c446f9 JSONL warnings.

UNKNOWN-VERB WARNINGS on session.jsonl (replayed by TaskJSONL, ext/JSONL/JSONL.js skip() line 119-125, called from apply() 90/104): session-e00f55c9/session.jsonl: by 289, ts 289, tasks 282, sessions 4, task 2, session 1, start 1, stop 1, as 1, moved_from 1; deputy/session.jsonl: commit 3, task 4, by 4, ts 4; deputy/roles and deputy/review-page: commit 3/2, wait 1/1.
